audit_findings.closure: The stable identity now binds the exact executable inventory bytes; preflight verifies repository cleanliness, inventory membership, per-file bytes, stable ancestry, post-stable executable diff, and import origins.
All public generation, resume, replay, and acceptance APIs require an unforgeable sealed preflight certificate before lock acquisition, root creation, or scientific writes.
Successful runs require a structured adapter result and exact science-artifact contract validation; arbitrary nonempty directories cannot transition to SUCCEEDED.
Replay validates generation ledger integrity, operation-independent campaign identity, executable/proposal/artifact identities, roots, run set, and all three seeds before simulation.
Acceptance independently validates generation and replay ledgers, source authorization and plan identities, complete run membership, all three seeds, artifact inventories, and replay reports.
The production adapter invokes authoritative per-run validation and returns a structured result that is checked against the exact artifact contract.

Portable regeneration is provided by one deterministic generator; Python checkout bytes are fixed to LF and fresh Windows core.autocrlf=true validation reproduced all proposal artifacts byte-for-byte.
Campaign and per-run exclusive-create locks contain PID and process-start identity; stale recovery is explicit, identity-validated, guarded, and recorded.
Plan, ledger, run-binding, replay, and acceptance records bind contract, executable, proposal, artifact-contract, authorization, run-record, design-record, realization, and three-seed identities.

required_next_task: Independent reaudit before any separate execution authorization decision
